title: Anna M NDE 739
content:
I was in surgery when something went wrong. I 'popped' from my body and was met with a bright light. This light gave me unconditional Love, and explained I had to return as I had three children to raise. Without words, I was told many mysteries of the world. There is no hell or heaven, there is just experience. No good or bad either! I had been taught wrong by Religion, and I had to return to find truth! I knew nothing about reincarnation and karma, and the Spirit world was to teach me to do it right! I had not yet 'Mastered' myself. I wanted to stay with this 'Presence' as I loved Him more than my family. I was popped back in my body in pain. I tore the needles out, and cried for days. Then I began to hear a ringing in my left ear and that was how I became intuitive. I could read astrology, learned in dreams. I am very spiritual now, and live each day like my last, though I do not fear death!

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Surgery-related Clinical death Heart stopped
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I had a shimmering body like millions of tiny lights.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: A 'POP' when I left the body.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain Felt like I was pulled through the top of my head, at the Crown Chakra.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes A Holy Presence that I was ashamed to look at. Just what I said before, Religion is a farce to keep the masses under control. I was told without words that I had to learn and help others in their growth.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was brighter than the Sun!
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It was in a very bright temple like structure.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I learned that if I did not Master myself, I would be subject to return to Earth.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw what looked like a deck of cards, each being a life I had led before on this Earth.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was upset to think I had to return to teach others what I learned.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Confidence because I was a co-worker with God. Compassion for the millions who are worshiping a symbol of God. Not the real deal!
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I read dreams, astrology and can tell who is sad or glad from across the room.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best - going and meeting the Presence. Worse - having to return to my body.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I read dreams on the net for others. They believe me as I am physic now.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Uncertain Contemplation will bring me close.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: There is only ONE God! He loves us all, no matter what! He does not judge.
